<color=#c0c0c0>While the mode is on, the hammer menu has every building unlocked, as in debugmode,
and you can deconstruct buildings without a station nearby. When it's off, only learned buildings remain.
If you turn «without support» off, unsupported structures fall at once.
When you build together, turn it on for both of you: collapse is counted by the game of whoever «owns» the area.</color>

<color=#c0c0c0>Settings the game itself doesn't have. Only how the picture is drawn for you changes; the game, friends and achievements are not affected. «Glow» is the halo around fire, lava and magic: if effects dazzle you, lower it.</color>

<color=#c0c0c0>Hide part of a building to see what is inside and how the structure holds. What is hidden is just not drawn for you: it is in place, solid (you can bump into it), and new pieces snap to it as usual. Friends see everything as always. A key to switch modes can be assigned in «Settings» → «Keys».</color>
